notes.title: Strange Creatures Patch 4.25
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

First of all we at Cat and Fiddle Games would like to thanks for all the amazing support you have shown us thus far.  We are so incredibly great full for every one of you. 

We have also been going through the feedback you have been sending us and are actively working on patches for the game to make Strange Creatures as great as it can be. 

With all that being said here are the first round of patch notes for the version 2.4 patch of Strange Creatures. 
1. Fixed an issue where Ernest's achievement cannot be unlocked.
2. Fixed a bug where players can drop out of  the level when moving to the next level.
3. Added functionality to the options menu to control volume settings
4. Now has fully functioning English Subtitles

notes.title: Patch Notes for April 2nd
notes.content:
Version	Change
3-26	1. Add Final Screen Monitor to the game.
	2. Boxes and players will be destroyed and respawn under the train.
	3. Objectives in the med bay and server room.

4-2	1. Arlo can automatically grab onto walls if reaching max stretch length.
	2. Fixed a bug with spawn points when going back to levels.
	3. Made changes to some props in the testing area.
		i . Catapults are movable now.
		Ii. Added some pushable large boxes.
		Iii. The walls in the testing area are now grabbable.
	4. Added more art assets in all rooms.
		I. Props for the med bay and the testing area.
		II. Wall textures for the testing area.
